Saudi Arabia ↔ Qatar

Saudi to Qatar private transfer by car via the Salwa border

Pre-booked private car with a professional driver, door to door across the Salwa border. One fixed fare in writing before you book.

Request a Cross-Border Quote Check availability on WhatsApp
Quick Answer

A Saudi to Qatar private transfer is a pre-booked car with a professional driver from your door in Saudi Arabia to your address in Doha, crossing at Salwa (Saudi side) and Abu Samra (Qatar side) — the only land border between the two countries. Al Ahsa is the closest major Saudi city (about 265 km to Doha), Dammam and Al Khobar about 400 km, Riyadh about 580 km. Border crossing fees are included in the fixed fare; each passenger carries their own documents.

Who this corridor serves and where we pick up

Three Saudi cities feed this corridor. Al Ahsa (Hofuf) is the shortest gateway; Dammam, Al Khobar and Dhahran are the busiest origins; Riyadh suits business travellers who want to skip a flight connection and work on the way.

In Qatar we drop at hotels, homes and offices across Doha — West Bay, The Pearl, Msheireb, Lusail — or at Hamad International Airport (DOH). Return trips from Doha to the Eastern Province and Riyadh run the same way in reverse.

Border crossing

What happens at the Salwa border

  1. 1. Pickup

    Your door in Saudi Arabia

    Dammam, Al Khobar, Al Ahsa or Riyadh — home, hotel or office.

  2. 2. Saudi exit

    Salwa border post

    Saudi exit checks at Salwa, completed by each passenger in person.

  3. 3. Qatar entry

    Abu Samra border post

    Qatar entry checks at Abu Samra, about 90 km from Doha.

  4. 4. Drop-off

    Your address in Doha

    West Bay, The Pearl, Lusail, Msheireb, Hamad International Airport or any address.

Salwa on the Saudi side and Abu Samra on the Qatari side form the only land crossing between Saudi Arabia and Qatar. Abu Samra is roughly 90 km from Doha. Border processing time is never guaranteed.

Practical notes for Qatar trips

Landing at Dammam airport?

Go straight from King Fahd International Airport (DMM) to Doha — no night in Dammam needed. Share your flight number when you book.

Qatar-side vehicle requirements

Qatar applies its own rules to vehicles entering at Abu Samra. Whether the car for your date meets them is confirmed before we send your fare.

Long stretch without towns

The road between Al Ahsa and Salwa is long and open. Rest and prayer stops are planned with you — mention children, elderly passengers or medical needs.

Flying out of Doha?

Tell us your flight time at Hamad International Airport and we plan the pickup with border time and check-in in mind.

Who books this transfer

  • Business between Dammam and Doha. Executive sedan or SUV for contractors, engineers and visiting staff — written quotes for companies.
  • Family visits. Saudi- and Qatar-based families travelling with luggage in an SUV or van, door to door.
  • Events and stopovers in Doha. One car for the round trip with the driver waiting, or two one-way legs on separate dates.

Vehicle options

  • Executive sedan — up to 3 passengers
  • Full-size SUV — families, more luggage
  • Van — groups and heavy luggage
  • Coaster — delegations, on request

Vehicles come from our vetted partner network; the car for your date is confirmed as eligible to cross before we quote.

See vehicle categories

Door-to-door or border drop-off?

Two ways to book this trip. Both have one fixed fare agreed in writing before you travel.

Recommended

Door-to-door

  • Same car and driver from your door to your address in Qatar
  • Vehicle crossing fees at the border included
  • No luggage transfers, no arranging transport on the other side

Border drop-off · lower fare

  • We drive you to the Saudi side of the border
  • Cheaper, because our car does not cross
  • You arrange your own onward transport on the other side, and check how passengers continue at this crossing

What passengers need at the border

  • A valid passport (or the ID your nationality may use for this crossing) for every passenger, including children.
  • The right to enter the destination country — visa, eVisa or exemption, depending on nationality.
  • Saudi residents: a valid exit and re-entry visa where it applies.
  • Requirements change. Confirm current entry rules with official sources before you travel — we do not arrange visas or immigration.

How booking works

  1. 1

    Send your trip. Route, date, passengers, luggage and vehicle — by form, WhatsApp or email.

  2. 2

    Written fixed fare. We confirm a vehicle and driver eligible for your crossing and send one fixed fare, with border crossing fees included. No meter, no surge.

  3. 3

    Door-to-door pickup. Your driver collects you at the agreed address and time.

  4. 4

    Border checks. Each passenger completes their own exit and entry checks. Border time varies and is never guaranteed.

  5. 5

    Drop-off. Straight to your hotel, home, office or airport on the other side.

What decides a cross-border fare

Cross-border trips are quoted individually — there is no meter and no surge. You receive one fixed fare in writing before you book, with border crossing fees for the vehicle included. It is based on:

  • Exact pickup and drop-off addresses
  • Border crossing and total distance
  • Vehicle class — executive sedan, full-size SUV, van
  • Passengers and large bags
  • Date and time of travel
  • One-way, return or driver waiting (15–30 min free waiting included)

Qatar cross-border transfer questions

Which border do you use to drive from Saudi Arabia to Qatar?

Salwa on the Saudi side and Abu Samra on the Qatari side. It is the only land crossing between the two countries, so every Saudi–Qatar road transfer uses it.

How far is Dammam from Doha by car?

Our Dammam to Doha route is listed at about 400 km, roughly 4 hours of driving plus time at the Salwa–Abu Samra border, which varies with traffic and checks.

What is the closest Saudi city to Qatar?

Of the major cities, Al Ahsa (Hofuf) is the closest to the Salwa border, which makes Al Ahsa to Doha the shortest of our Saudi–Qatar routes.

What documents do I need to enter Qatar by road?

Each passenger needs a valid passport or accepted ID and the right to enter Qatar; Saudi residents generally also need a valid exit and re-entry visa. Rules change, so confirm current requirements with official sources before travel. We do not arrange visas.

Can I book a return trip from Doha to Saudi Arabia?

Yes. Doha to Dammam and Doha to Riyadh run as their own routes, or the same driver can wait in Doha and bring you back as a return booking.

Can my company get a written quote for Qatar transfers?

Yes. Send an email RFQ with routes, dates, passengers and vehicles and we reply in writing. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.
